title: •Emperor’s Power
caption: •Emperor’s Power (V)
game_text: Deploy on Emperor. Jedi are power -1 and deploy +1. During opponent’s move phase, if Emperor present with Vader (or with two Imperial Council Members at Conference Room or any Throne Room), opponent loses 1 Force.
lore: From his throne room aboard the second Death Star, Emperor Palpatine monitors activity throughout the galaxy.
